_readme: Platform registry for Obi embed. 'platforms' = trusted JWT issuers keyed by platform key; an entry keys the trusted-issuer verification config. 'integrations' is the set of valid integration CLAIM VALUES (keys only; the knowledge-scope value lists are retired and empty per ADR-routing-labels-sole-content-axis — content routing now rides the ADR-directed-source-target-routing-labels routing-label axis, not knowledge scopes). Each platform's 'allowed_integrations' (gap CIP-A1) lists the integration CLAIM VALUES that platform is trusted to assert: a self-serving platform lists only its own (mews->[mews], toast->[toast], opera-cloud->[opera-cloud]); build_auth_context REJECTS (401) a verified token whose 'integration' is not in the issuing platform's list, so a trusted issuer can no longer claim another tenant's integration. datahub's allowed_integrations ([mews,toast,opera-cloud]) is the HUB's vend set and is an OWNER TRUST DECISION (decision-needed): confirm the Data Hub is trusted to vend exactly these product integrations. Validated at startup (backend/app/platform/config/platforms.py): every allowed_integrations value must be a key of the integrations map; lifetime_minutes within 1..1440; every alg on the allow-list (RS256, ES256); outside local, zero active platforms stops startup. obi-test is a TEMPORARY active platform (Supabase Auth issuer) so the backend boots in production before Phase 4.x; remove it once datahub is live. Base (Marien's integration) and Data Hub (Jasper's integration) are TWO separate platforms on two different sites, each its own entry. base: issuer + JWKS as given by Base for its dev environment (2026-10-16), RS256 only, domains base.development.omniboost.io (dev) + app.omniboost.io (live); INACTIVE until its JWKS serves keys (it returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-16) — activating earlier would make every Base token fail verification; the live issuer/JWKS for app.omniboost.io are still to come. datahub: domain datahub.omniboost.io; issuer/JWKS still TODO (Jasper). base's allowed_integrations ([mews,toast,opera-cloud]) mirrors datahub's and is the same OWNER TRUST DECISION (decision-needed). All three hosts are ALSO listed on obi-test (owner-approved 2026-10-15/16) so the frame CSP lets them embed general-only chat today; drop each from obi-test when its own platform goes active. base (inactive, see above), datahub (issuer/jwks are TODO placeholders until Phase 4.x; domain datahub.omniboost.io), mews, toast and opera-cloud are present and inactive. Entries with active=false are skipped by the frame CSP and the frontend loader, STILL verify a token if one arrives (by_issuer), but are DENIED scoped access at build_auth_context (AUTH-1/CIP-A2: platform_for serves only active entries).
